mapper.select: SELECT user_id, last_factory_id, revision FROM mf_user_preference WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE mf_user_preference SET last_factory_id = #{lastFactoryId}, revision = revision + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND revision = #{revision}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO mf_user_preference(user_id, last_factory_id, revision) VALUES(#{userId}, #{lastFactoryId}, 1)
